group27.interpretation: The alternative reduces the group27 screenshot impact substantially. At 68.05 the authored hall moves from upper/mid left into small low-left region; at 66.35 it is not detectably changing the frame. A single building may naturally leave a 180-190m/s camera between times, so this fact ALONE is not a failure; the failure is the overall frame still lacks any readable successor landmark linking basin->intake->working quay.
